# MysticDo

> Match Your Spiritual Needs. Choose What to Do Next.
> An intent-driven spiritual decision platform: get personalized guidance for your spiritual questions about psychic readings, tarot, astrology, numerology, manifestation, and more — so you can find what fits your needs and avoid making the wrong choice.
> MysticDo sits in the narrow space between "I'm curious" and "I'm ready to buy." It does not publish horoscopes or a knowledge encyclopedia. It helps users figure out whether they need a psychic, tarot, astrology, or medium reading — and which provider is worth their money — before they pay.

## Start here (comprehensive matcher)
- Do What Fits (7-question matcher, no signup): https://mysticdo.com/do-what-fits.html

## Notes
- All content is HTML text — key facts, prices, and comparison data are never trapped in images.
- Each commercial page uses a GEO-friendly structure: Direct Answer → Key Takeaways → Comparison table → Real user scenarios → Decision tree → FAQ → Methodology.
- Affiliate links are disclosed and never affect ranking. See /methodology.html.
